name: lux-android
description: Aplicación Android local de Lux, sin backend ni servidor externo.

scripts.android:prepare: npm run android:add && node scripts/configure-android.mjs && npm run android:assets && npm run android:sync
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
